basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 DEO, MTS Posts
basic_details.short_information: Centre for Dental Education and Research (CDER), All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi is hiring for 2 temporary contractual field posts—Data Entry Operator and Multi-Tasking Staff—under the 'National Oral Disease Burden Survey' of the National Oral Health Program, MoHFW, Government of India, offering consolidated salary as per AIIMS/ICMR/GOI guidelines for an initial tenure up to 31 March 2027 to candidates having 12th pass with typing skills or High School pass, who must submit the online Google Form by 11 November 2026 before 17:00 PM and send hard copies by post to rea

how_to_apply: Candidates must complete both the online submission and send the hard copies by post; completing only one mode will lead to rejection.
Fill out the official Google Form through the prescribed link or QR code and upload clear scanned copies of the application form and supporting documents.
Take a printout of the successfully submitted Google Form.
Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (C.V.) along with self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, valid ID proof, age proof, and the signed declaration form.
If applying for more than one post, prepare and submit separate applications and documentation sets for each post.
Place the application and documents inside a sealed envelope and label the cover as: “Application for the post of [Post Name] under National Oral Disease Burden Survey”.

Send the sealed envelope by post only to: 6th Floor, Lab-2, NaRRIDS (National Oral Health Program/ National Oral Disease Burden Survey), Centre for Dental Education and Research (CDER), All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi 110029.
important_instructions: Submission of documents by both Google Form and post is mandatory; incomplete submissions will be summarily rejected. The positions involve extensive house-to-house survey work and continuous travel across India with no provision for returning to Delhi between field visits. Travel expenses and accommodation must initially be borne by the employee and will be reimbursed later on an actual basis; no advance payment is permissible. No additional allowances will be given for any travel days or field visits. No leave will be permitted during the days of travel for the survey and active field work and when on survey-related travel (except emergency medical conditions). Active field work requires full-time availability; any refusal to perform duty and travel shall be treated as refusal to work and termination of employment, with no entitlement to salary, reimbursements, experience certificate, or other benefits. Engagement in private practice, tuition, coaching, or online consultations (paid or charitable) is strictly prohibited during the employment period. Selected candidates must join duties immediately or within a maximum of 15 days from the issue of the offer letter, failing which the offer stands cancelled. A candidate wishing to resign after joining must provide a 15 days' notice period or deposit salary in lieu thereof. A waiting list of candidates will be maintained and remain valid for a duration of 6 months. Official communication regarding shortlisting and interview will be sent solely via email to the address provided in the online form.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Centre for Dental Education and Research (CDER) at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, is conducting this recruitment under the National Oral Health Program (NOHP), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. The appointed personnel are engaged specifically for the 'National Oral Disease Burden Survey' to execute extensive field-level data collection activities. The operational base for project administration is the NaRRIDS facility located at the CDER building within the AIIMS New Delhi campus.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 contractual vacancies have been announced for outstation field work, and the number of vacancies may increase or decrease as per the requirement on the day of the interview. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the minimum prescribed qualifications, computer skills, and age limits as stipulated in the official notification. Age relaxation is admissible as per ICMR rules. The post-wise age limits are as follows: Data Entry Operator (for outstation fieldwork): Age Limit: 28 years (Relaxable as per ICMR rules). Multi-Tasking Staff (for outstation fieldwork): Age Limit: 25 years (Relaxable as per ICMR rules). Candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete discipline-specific eligibility requirements of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Intermediate or 12th pass from a recognized board, and a speed test of not less than 15,000 key depressions per hour through speed test on computer.
rows.desirable: Any Graduate Degree with excellent proficiency in MS-Office and other allied computer software; one-year experience in data entry or related work experience in drafting letters/office work.
One-year experience of epidemiological data collection in the field; knowledge of computer data entry.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Salary and other admissible allowances will be paid in accordance with AIIMS, ICMR, and Government of India guidelines. In addition, TA/DA for travel during survey work will be provided strictly on a reimbursement basis as per Government of India rules upon submission of prescribed proforma, actual bills, and declarations; no advance payment will be granted. The appointment is purely temporary and contractual, initially up to 31 March 2027, with extensions subject to project needs and availability of funds. Performance will be reviewed every 30 days, and the contract may be terminated on one day's notice if found unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: These appointments are strictly for field visits and house-to-house surveys across various states of India, and not for routine office work at CDER, AIIMS New Delhi. Direct field engagement and data collection in various parts of the country as assigned. Continuous travel between states according to the duty schedule without returning to Delhi between field visits. Submission of daily and periodic work progress reports as an essential requirement. Tasks as assigned by the project-in-charge or authority (during travel, candidates will be answerable to the assigned team leader, and the competent authority retains the right to assign field work travel or any other work for CDER, AIIMS).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete both the online submission and send the hard copies by post; completing only one mode will lead to rejection. Fill out the official Google Form through the prescribed link or QR code and upload clear scanned copies of the application form and supporting documents. Take a printout of the successfully submitted Google Form. Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (C.V.) along with self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, valid ID proof, age proof, and the signed declaration form. If applying for more than one post, prepare and submit separate applications and documentation sets for each post. Place the application and documents inside a sealed envelope and label the cover as: “Application for the post of [Post Name] under National Oral Disease Burden Survey”. Send the sealed envelope by post only to: 6th Floor, Lab-2, NaRRIDS (National Oral Health Program/ National Oral Disease Burden Survey), Centre for Dental Education and Research (CDER), All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi 110029.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printout of the completed and submitted Google Form. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (C.V.). Self-attested copies of all educational qualification certificates. Self-attested copies of experience certificates issued by valid employers. Self-attested copy of age proof certificate. Valid Photo ID proof. Signed declaration form (obtained via the official QR code/link). Certificate from a recognized board or institution in case an additional degree or advanced course has been undertaken.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A merit list will be prepared based on percentage marks obtained in the Essential Qualification (overall for the course), desirable qualifications, merit, and experience. Based on merit and years of experience, candidates will be shortlisted in a 1:5 ratio per post to appear for an in-person interview. In the event of a tie in marks, preference will be given to candidates possessing additional desirable qualifications. The selection committee reserves the right to conduct a written test, computer exercises, or clinical examination before the interview, and a typing speed test will be conducted for the Data Entry Operator post. Interviews will be conducted in person only; no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 contractual vacancies: 1 post for Data Entry Operator (for outstation fieldwork) and 1 post for Multi-Tasking Staff (for outstation fieldwork).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online Google Form is 11 November 2026 before 17:00 PM, and the hard copies sent by post must reach by 16 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (12th) from a recognized board and possess a computer typing speed of not less than 15,000 key depressions per hour.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Multi-Tasking Staff post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a High School (10th) pass certificate or an equivalent qualification from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. What are the age limits for DEO and MTS posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years for Data Entry Operator and 25 years for Multi-Tasking Staff, with relaxations admissible under ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Salary and allowances will be paid in accordance with AIIMS, ICMR, and Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted in a 1:5 ratio per post based on percentage marks in essential qualifications, desirable qualifications, merit, and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a purely temporary, contractual appointment initially valid up to 31 March 2027, extendable based on project requirements and funding availability.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates wishing to apply for more than one post must submit separate application forms and postal packages for each post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location and nature of work?
faq.answer: The work involves extensive outstation travel and house-to-house survey data collection across various states of India under the National Oral Disease Burden Survey.
